Messages.Author: hen...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
A few more questions and statements...

Derange, says it can't be PLAYED on a !Malk, but can it be MOVED to a !
Malk?

Derange [Sabbat]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Dementation
This is a +1 stealth action. (D) Put this card on a vampire. The
vampire with this card is now considered to be a Malkavian Antitribu
and is no longer a member of his or her original clan. The vampire with
this card may move it <to another vampire> as a (D) action. This card
cannot be played on a Malkavian Antitribu. (S) As above, and the
vampire with this card does not untap as normal. {During his or her
controller's untap phase}, he or she may burn 1 blood to untap.

Can I untap when someone I normally cannot block does an action, i.e.
my grandsire? And if that's allowed, whats stopping me from trying to
untap and attempt to block (and fail of course) my own vampires? Hey,
unlimited freak drives!!!

Eternal Vigilance [SW]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 1 blood
Requires a ready Archbishop, Priscus or Cardinal. +1 stealth. Put this
card on the acting vampire. During an action, the Sabbat vampire with
this card can pay a blood to untap and attempt to block. Burn this card
if this Sabbat vampire goes to torpor.

Greger is misprinted. A Swedish name is Andersson, Anderssen is danish
or norwegian... And the thought that a danish guy could be prince of
Stockholm didn't even occur to me...
Greger Anderssen [DS]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Malkavian
Capacity: 7
Discipline: OBF AUS dom pro
Prince of Stockholm

Is the damage refered to the damage the vampire would inflict on a
strike? I.e. can a Meat Cleaver be burnt if Lazverinus has it?
Illegal Search and Seizure [Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Master
Master. You may burn one weapon that costs more than 2 pool or inflicts
more than 3 damage. The bearer of the weapon takes 1 damage. This
damage cannot be prevented.

Do I draw an extra card when I replace Infernal Pursuit?

Infernal Pursuit [Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Celerity
Press. (S) For the remainder of the combat, each time you replace a
card, draw an additional card and then burn one card in your hand for
each additional card drawn.

Are cards playable on Non-camarilla now also playable on Sabbat? Kinda
makes this card a little boring: "Oops, they burned Moncada..."

Protect Thine Own [AH]
Cardtype: Political Action
Cost: 1 blood
Political Card-Worth 1 Vote. Called by any Justicar or Inner Circle
member at +1 stealth. Choose a Non-Camarilla vampire with a capacity
below 6. If the acting vampire is a member of the Inner Circle, you may
choose any Non-Camarilla vampire instead. If this <referendum> is
successful, burn that vampire.

Can Shackles be burned by a minion before it has shackled someone?
Shackles of Enkidu [DS]
Cardtype: Equipment
Clan: Gangrel
Cost: 2 pool
Unique equipment. Before range is chosen in a round of combat, you may
put the Shackles on any minion opposing the vampire with this card;
{this vampire still controls this card, however}. Combat ends. The
Shackled minion does not untap <as normal> during his or her untap
phases; he or she burns 2 blood during each of your untap phases. Any
minion may burn this card as a (D) action.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
hen...@my-deja.com wrote:
> Derange, says it can't be PLAYED on a !Malk, but can it be MOVED to a !
> Malk?

No. "Playing" doesn't restrict itself to "from the hand".

> [Eternal Vigilance]

> Can I untap when someone I normally cannot block does an action, i.e.
> my grandsire? And if that's allowed, whats stopping me from trying to
> untap and attempt to block (and fail of course) my own vampires? Hey,
> unlimited freak drives!!!

No. The same applies to Second Tradtion.

> Greger is misprinted. A Swedish name is Andersson, Anderssen is danish
> or norwegian...

OK.

> Is the damage refered to the damage the vampire would inflict on a
> strike? I.e. can a Meat Cleaver be burnt if Lazverinus has it?
> Illegal Search and Seizure [Jyhad, V:TES]

* A weapon's "current damage" is the amount of damage that the weapon
would inflict if used as a strike by bearer against a generic
opponent. (This affects Concealed Weapon, Illegal Search and Seizure,
and Machine Blitz). [RTR 19980623]

> Do I draw an extra card when I replace Infernal Pursuit?

Yes.

> Are cards playable on Non-camarilla now also playable on Sabbat? Kinda
> makes this card a little boring: "Oops, they burned Moncada..."
>
> Protect Thine Own [AH]

Yes. Sabbat vamps are not Camarilla.

> Can Shackles be burned by a minion before it has shackled someone?

No. (Well, except by generic "burn equipment" effects, contesting,
etc.)
